items.title: Dominic James "Nick" La Rocca Interview, 1958-05-21
items.q: That was the great Anthony from Louisiana Five... I had played with him in 1914. I never even knew the man.

ctx.x: does it sound like to you? It's going to sound like anything, conventional music. That's what it sounds like. And I want you to know that they were impressed with the Dixon band because they come up one year after. Listen to the novel at the hook and towel. They heard the rooster crow and the donkey bread. So they'll come out with their novel. This band was imported to New York to compete against us on the victim. They were a flock. They went into the hands of the receiver. That's where I got that bogus check.…
